name: natune-site
description: Public Natune website — landing page, static news API and admin for natune.pages.dev

scripts.dev: node scripts/build.mjs && npx wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.deploy: node scripts/build.mjs && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name natune
scripts.test: node scripts/test-security.mjs && node scripts/test-site.mjs && node scripts/test-landing.mjs
